svg.title: OpenAMRobot platform architecture
svg.desc: Architecture diagram. ROS 2 functional stack (Raspberry Pi 5 · no Performance Level claim): Nav2 planning and control, Velocity smoother, Collision monitor, Command arbiter (twist_mux), Docking inside the envelope, Operator UI with authentication, SROS2, pinned builds, Learned policy, outside every safety function. Teensy 4.0 firmware (Hardened checker · no Performance Level claim in the first safety case): Command validation: finite, bounded, fresh, Hardware watchdog, Driver fault read-back, Encoder and stall plausibility, Debug paths armed, parameters bounded, Version, reset cause, calibration flag. Safety-related control system (PL d target · ISO 13849-1 · nothing in software can hold a contactor closed): Two-channel E-stops, Safety relay with monitored reset, Two contactors, mirror contacts, Brakes engaged on power loss, Safety scanner OSSDs, Fuse and lockable disconnect. A cross-cutting safety and assurance column of draft work products applies to every layer: Machine limits and risk assessment, Safety functions and required PL, SRP/CS architecture and PL calculation, Stopping, detection and E-stop validation, Cybersecurity threat assessment, Safety case and technical file, Decision register and gates. Legend: Inherited, functional only; Hardened by the fork (proposed); To be built, PL d target; Proposed, not yet in any repository.
